h:
“非常简单”的工作流程，

请阅读节点，它们有一些提示，然后您可以删除

所有控制都是通过旁路节点（左侧）进行的，为了进行更精细的调整，您可以使用组内的节点。

高档可以有或没有模特

在 I2I 中，路线图像的预设尺寸为移动设备 5:8 和桌面设备 16:9。通过“潜在”组进行控制

T2I 后图像尺寸：移动 - 800x1280 (WXGA)，桌面 - 1280x720 (720p)

I2I 后图像尺寸：移动 -1200x1920 (WUXGA)，桌面 - 1920x1080 (1080p)

终极标清后图像尺寸：移动 - 1600x2560(WQXGA)，桌面 - 2560x1440 (2K)

对于迭代路线，更改其组中的放大因子（低于 1 将缩小）

您可以通过更改 DetectorProvider 来更改详细信息的类型

小心使用守护进程，如果你不知道它是什么，就不要碰:)

与 Civitai 兼容的保护器

o.en:
"Pretty simple" workflow,

Please, read nodes, they have some hints, then you can delete then

All control is carried out through the bypass nodes (at the left), for more fine tuning, you can use nodes within groups.

Upscale can be done with or without a model

In I2I route image have preset sizes for mobile 5:8 and desktop 16:9. Control through group "Latent"

After T2I image size: mobile - 800x1280 (WXGA), desktop - 1280x720 (720p)

After I2I image size: mobile -1200x1920 (WUXGA), desktop - 1920x1080 (1080p)

After Ultimate SD image size: mobile - 1600x2560(WQXGA), desktop - 2560x1440 (2K)

For iterative route change upscale factor in its group (lower then 1 will downscale)

You can change the type of detailer by changing DetectorProvider

Use daemon carefully, if you don't know what it is, just don't touch :)

Saver compatible with Civitai
